title: A method moved down inside its class is named by the method, not the class
expected: tax() moved below describe(); the Sem tab names it "tax", never "Order".

title: A method moved inside a nested class is named by the method, not by either class
expected: hit() moved below render() inside Registry.Entry; named "hit", never "Entry" or "Registry".

title: Two methods swapped: the move is named by a method, never by the class
expected: area() and perimeter() swapped. The shorter area() is the one that moved (perimeter() stays matched); named "area", never "Shapes". A claim on perimeter instead is also true but not expected.

title: A moved method whose body also changed is not a plain move
expected: count() moved up (plain move, named "count"); min() moved to the end AND its start value changed from MAX_VALUE to MIN_VALUE, so it is movedWithEdit or edited, never plain moved.

title: A method moved to the end of its class: no "added" blank line or closing brace
expected: count() moved to the end of Cart. Only the move is shown; the blank line before it and the class's closing brace are unchanged, never added or deleted.

title: The last method moved to the top: the brace and blank it leaves are not deleted
expected: reset() moved from the end of Timer to the top. The blank line before it and the class's closing brace stay; never deleted on the old side, never added after it on the new side.

title: Last method of a nested class moved up: neither closing brace is added or deleted
expected: validate() moved to the top of Builder. The two closing braces at the end (Builder's and Outer's) and the blank line are unchanged.

title: A private helper moved to the end past two methods: no stray added or deleted lines
expected: peek() moved to the end of Parser. Nothing else changed: no added blank line or brace near it, nothing deleted where it was.

title: A method rename whose callers come first in the file is named by the declaration
expected: computeTotal renamed to calculateTotal with both callers. The first changed lines are call sites in summary() and isLarge(); the Sem tab names the rename "computeTotal -> calculateTotal", never by a caller.

title: A private method renamed with its one caller is named by the declaration
expected: expired renamed to isExpired (declaration and the call in check()); named "expired -> isExpired", never "check" or "Session".

title: A field renamed with its uses is named by the field declaration
expected: Field count renamed to total in its declaration and three methods; named "count -> total", never by a method that uses it.

title: A method rename hides a changed call on one caller line
expected: computeTotal renamed to calculateTotal (declaration and quote()); in quoteRounded the same line also changed Math.round to Math.floor, so that line is an edit, not part of the rename. Named by the declaration.

title: One of three overloads moved; overloads pair by parameter types
expected: format(String) moved to the end, unchanged. format(double) stayed and changed %.2f to %.3f (an edit). The move pairs format(String) with itself, not with another format overload; named "format".

title: A method with Javadoc and annotations moved: they travel with it
expected: get() moved to the end with its Javadoc, @Nullable and @Deprecated. One move covering the Javadoc and annotations; none of those lines is added or deleted.

title: An instance method moved from one class to another in the same file changes meaning
expected: fee() left Account and now sits in Ledger: same text, but balance is now Ledger.balance and Account callers break. Edited (deleted from Account, added to Ledger), never a plain move.

title: A private static pure helper moved between two classes in one file
expected: strip() reads no fields and has no callers in Paths; moving it to Urls changes only where it lives (Paths.strip no longer exists). Defensible as moved (same code, no state) or as edited (it changed class, as the decided rule says for scope changes).

title: An instance method moved from the outer class into its nested static class
expected: port() moved into Config.Defaults (re-indented). In a static nested class props is no longer reachable and Config.port() is gone: the meaning changed, so edited, never a plain move.

title: Imports sorted: a reorder, not added and deleted imports
expected: The four imports were sorted; nothing else changed.
